title: 2.12 Don't eat in the classroom
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Understand classroom commands: Siéntate. Escribe tu nombre. No comas en el salón.
grammar_function: tú commands (siéntate, escribe, abre); no + command (no comas, no uses).
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1 and A1+ 2.1-2.11.
speaking_outcome: Understand classroom commands: Siéntate. Escribe tu nombre. No comas en el salón.
